exposure: information described and presented by childbirth educators during antenatal classes
language structures used when discussing labour and birth
outcome: discussion of the rest period between contractions
cohort: The participants were three childbirth educators providing information to expectant parents during antenatal classes at a single tertiary referral centre.
finding: During labour and birth classes, information statements were the predominant language structure, but negative statements were also common, particularly regarding the second stage of labour, despite being potentially unhelpful.
